description.value: Tiffany & Co. The Landmark is the brand's flagship store on Fifth Avenue. Wikipedia notes that the building, at 727 Fifth Avenue, has served as Tiffany & Co. 's sixth flagship store since its completion in 1940. The main store reopened on April 27, 2023, and at that point the store had forty artworks by artists including Damien Hirst and others. It sits on Fifth Avenue at 57th Street in Midtown's luxury shopping district. Representative Tripadvisor praise (search snapshot): “They have exclusive items for sale at this location which does make it special”. Representative watch-outs: “I was a little disappointed in the quality of the workmanship of Tiffany’s pieces”.
